paraphrase: Subscriptions must be truthful and transparent: offer terms, cost, billing frequency, automatic renewal, whether a subscription is needed to use the app and other material facts must be shown without the user taking extra steps; subscriptions must give sustained or recurring value (one-time benefits such as lump-sum credits must be in-app products) and may not be reduced to a one-time offering after purchase; annual prices may not be shown mainly as a monthly figure; SKU names like "Free Trial" may not hide an auto-recurring charge; purchase flows may not lead users into accidental subscribe taps, and there must be a visible way to continue without subscribing; pricing and terms must be fully localised. Trials and introductory offers must state duration, price, what is included, how and when they convert to a paid subscription, the paid price, and how to cancel. The app must disclose how to manage or cancel and must give in-app access to an easy online cancellation method (for example a link to Google Play's Subscription Center in account settings); cancellation normally takes effect at the end of the current billing period.
